claim: The Barkour paper (Caluwaerts et al. 2023) trains specialist locomotion skills using on-policy RL then distills into a Locomotion-Transformer generalist policy; training budget not explicitly reported in abstract.
stance_target: training budget for Barkour quadruped locomotion
scope_conditions: Google custom quadruped, on-policy RL + distillation pipeline, abs page only
quoted_support: we train specialist locomotion skills using on-policy reinforcement learning methods and combine them with a high-level navigation controller. In the second approach, we distill the specialist skills into a Transformer-based generalist locomotion policy
